environment.description: Deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) a custom rule group 'corp-request-inspection' at priority 1 with a RegexPatternSet match on query string and body using pattern `(?i)(?:'|\x27|%27)\s*(?:OR|AND|UNION|SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|;|--|#|/\*)` with action BLOCK and CloudWatch metric 'SQLiCustomBlock', and (2) AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 2 with SizeRestriction_BODY overridden to COUNT. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to a Kinesis Firehose stream but this is observability-only. The container runs with an IAM task role that has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/BoundaryNoExternalNet) denying ec2:CreateNetworkInterface and all s3:* actions, though this is unrelated to the SQL injection vector.

config.alb_access_logs: enabled, shipped to Kinesis Firehose (observability only)
config.network: Private subnet, SG allows inbound only from ALB SG
